html:
Here is a version of the Veil Nebula in the hydrogen alpha emission band.



For this photo, here are the technical parameters
Date:  2010/08/18
Optical train = Takahashi Sky90 + f4.5 reducer - Astronomik Ha 13 nm filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the SkyVoyager software via Skyfi
Site: At home
20 exposures of 10 min for 200 minutes
Dark, flat and bias applied
DeepSkyStacker + PhotoShop
Guided with Kwik Guider and the Phd software
